# Autognose (自知)

> A self-aware knowledge layer for RAG and agents. No code yet. Research and documentation only.

## Site
- [Overview](https://oasis-ai-lab.github.io/Autognose/)
- [Research](https://oasis-ai-lab.github.io/Autognose/research/): four research questions, eight open decisions, publications
- [Architecture](https://oasis-ai-lab.github.io/Autognose/architecture/): system overview, candidate mechanisms, design principles
- [Documentation](https://oasis-ai-lab.github.io/Autognose/documentation/): honest index of existing and planned documents
- [Development](https://oasis-ai-lab.github.io/Autognose/development/): experiments, roadmap, changelog
- [About](https://oasis-ai-lab.github.io/Autognose/about/): background, contributing, contact

## Research
- [Self-Aware Knowledge Base · survey v0.1](https://oasis-ai-lab.github.io/Autognose/report/): 2026-09, 40+ works. Historical document, not a specification.
